scenes.title: Norman's Driving Practice
scenes.summary: Gabriel helps Norman Thavaud practice driving before his test.

scenes.title: Begging the Receptionist
scenes.summary: Gabriel begs the driving center receptionist to move Norman's test date forward.

scenes.title: Breakfast with Mom
scenes.summary: Camille and her mother Annick have breakfast. Annick wants to meet Mathias.

scenes.title: Morning at ASK
scenes.summary: Gabriel chats with Sofia and Camille. Camille asks Gabriel to join lunch with her mom.

scenes.title: Andréa and Aymeline
scenes.summary: Andréa meets with model Aymeline Val to discuss launching her acting career.

scenes.title: A Singer for Julien
scenes.summary: Gabriel tells Sofia that Julien Doré is looking for a singer and prepares her to meet him.

scenes.title: Meeting Julien Doré
scenes.summary: Julien Doré pitches his movie ending, and Gabriel introduces Sofia as a potential singer.

scenes.title: Hicham Arrives
scenes.summary: Hicham introduces himself to Julien Doré and mistakenly hits on Aymeline Val.

scenes.title: Professional Boundaries
scenes.summary: Andréa warns Gabriel not to hit on her client Aymeline Val.

scenes.title: Overdiversification
scenes.summary: Mathias warns Sofia against trying to be both a singer and an actress.

scenes.title: Nathalie Baye's Schedule
scenes.summary: Noémie tries to organize Nathalie Baye's shooting schedule while flirting with Mathias.

scenes.title: Elvis Visits ASK
scenes.summary: Hicham brings his son Elvis to the office and gives Camille tickets to a PSG match.

scenes.title: Swapping Test Dates
scenes.summary: Gabriel introduces Norman to Violaine, a fan who agrees to swap driving test dates for a selfie.

scenes.title: Laser Game Party
scenes.summary: Elvis demands a laser game party for his birthday. Hicham tasks Camille with organizing it.

scenes.title: Lunch Plans
scenes.summary: Camille and Noémie prepare for lunch with Annick.

scenes.title: Reunion at Grand Colbert
scenes.summary: Annick and Mathias meet for coffee at the Grand Colbert restaurant.

scenes.title: Catherine's Surprise Visit
scenes.summary: Mathias's wife Catherine arrives at the office. Noémie panics and tries to warn Mathias.

scenes.title: Awkward Encounter
scenes.summary: Noémie and Catherine both arrive at the Grand Colbert, leading to an awkward encounter with Annick.

scenes.title: Arguing Over the Apartment
scenes.summary: Catherine and Mathias argue bitterly over their divorce and the apartment.

scenes.title: A Fucking Huge Party
scenes.summary: Hicham changes his mind about the laser game and demands a huge party for Elvis with celebrities.

scenes.title: Méthodes de relaxation
scenes.summary: Gabriel worries about Norman's test. Hervé offers organic weed and pills to relax him.

scenes.title: Le permis de conduire
scenes.summary: Norman takes his driving test while under the influence and miraculously passes.

scenes.title: Arrivée au Laser Game
scenes.summary: Hicham, Elvis, and Norman arrive at the laser game party.

scenes.title: Julien veut partir
scenes.summary: Gabriel finds Julien Doré wanting to leave the party. Gabriel encourages Sofia to talk to him.

scenes.title: Laser Tag Battle
scenes.summary: Hicham enjoys playing laser tag. Norman talks to Gabriel about his movie role.

scenes.title: Joyride
scenes.summary: Elvis goads Norman into taking Hicham's car for a spin. Hicham and Gabriel argue.

scenes.title: Working Late
scenes.summary: Mathias and Noémie work late on schedules, apologize to each other, and share an intimate moment.

scenes.title: Sofia Sings
scenes.summary: Sofia sings in the studio for Julien Doré. Everyone is amazed by her voice.

scenes.title: Garde à vue pour Norman et Gabriel
scenes.summary: Hicham and Gabriel arrive at the police station. Norman wants to quit Audiard's movie. Gabriel pretends to cancel it and gets arrested himself.

scenes.title: Libérés de cellule
scenes.summary: Gabriel and Norman talk in the cell. The police officer, moved by Norman's fear, lets them go.

scenes.title: Le lendemain matin chez ASK
scenes.summary: The agents greet each other at the office after a crazy weekend.
